about: Curated deck profiles for elevated / long structures (tpipe.roadnet, docs/ROADS.md). profile = [lon, lat, height m]; mode above_ground = height over the (150 m smoothed) bare-earth terrain, absolute = datum metres. Vertices of matching strokes (by name or OSM way id, class <= max_class) within `snap` m of the control polyline are pinned to the interpolated height; ramps (links) are pinned only where they are bridges. Heights are estimates from the cited sources; see docs/ROADS.md.

sources: Dillon/Waterfront Toronto, Gardiner East EA Appendix J, Infrastructure Baseline Conditions (2016): 2-3 column bents, reinforced-concrete caps, 18-21 m spans (30 m at Yonge, Jarvis, Sherbourne, Parliament, Cherry), 33-44 m deck width Yonge-DVP. https://www.waterfrontoronto.ca/sites/default/files/documents/appendix-j---infrastructure-baseline-conditions-report---2016-09-22.pdf
